budgetyourtripProxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Copenhagen? Hotel Prices for Copenhagen, Denmark | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtripProxy.evidenceText: $131 is the average price of the 9 1-star hotels in Copenhagen; BudgetYourTrip states hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes. Its Copenhagen cost page reports $193 (kr1,255) for two people in a typical double-occupancy hotel room.
budgetyourtripProxy.referencePeriod: Search results retrieved 2026-08-01; source page uses current listing sample.
budgetyourtripProxy.reason: Source-defined class average retained as a proxy only; it is not a directly observed two-adult booking quote.
